learning_objective: 🎯 Let us unlock our imagination to write beautiful paragraphs and learn how to write polite letters!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A paragraph is a family of sentences all talking about one topic! Pick a fun topic (like My Pet). Write 4 to 5 sentences that connect to each other smoothly.
Sometimes you get sick or have to go to a family wedding. A leave application is a formal, polite letter telling your Principal or Teacher why you cannot come to school.
A formal letter has steps! First the Date, then To The Principal. Next is the Subject (why you are writing). Then the main message, and lastly Thank You with your name!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Dream Pet Paragraph!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you could have ANY animal as a pet (even a dragon!). Write a short paragraph of 4 sentences describing what your dream pet looks like and what you would play together.

quick_recap: ⭐ A paragraph is a group of sentences about a single topic.
⭐ A leave application is a letter asking for days off from school.
⭐ Letters have a special format: Date, Receiver, Subject, Body, and Closing.
